limitations: Not an exhaustive or authenticated search of all four platforms.
Search results sometimes ignored domain or date constraints; unrelated/off-platform results were not counted as platform evidence.
Relative timestamps from search snippets were not used as verified publication dates.
Social claims and popularity are discovery signals, never paper evidence or a shared benchmark ranking.
Unresolved social leads without an arXiv ID are kept here, separate from the two pending arXiv candidates in data/screening.json.
The new paper was submitted in September; this review adds a missed paper, not a claim of a newly submitted October paper.
